_report_url_note: Where the human-readable HTML report is served, e.g. https://<your-host>.ts.net:8446/ . LEAVE THIS EMPTY IN THE REPO and set the LOREPORT_REPORT_URL environment variable instead — this file is public, and a tailnet hostname is deployment-specific, not framework config. Handed to CLOUD callers too: security rests on tailscale auth, never on URL secrecy. CONSTRAINT: if the report is ever moved to public serving, revisit that — giving a cloud provider the URL would then be giving it every private entry.
